re-cost-seg.price: Rapid Report from $950; Fully Engineered from $2,320 residential and $2,730 commercial.
re-cost-seg.priceQuestion: Which study product fits the property, and does the written fee include the chosen inspection method?

re-cost-seg.model: Rapid uses an owner questionnaire; Fully Engineered adds virtual or in-person inspection.

cost-seg-smart.priceQuestion: Which property matrix and price band apply, and which add-ons or custom scoping are required?
cost-seg-smart.reviewQuestion: Check the property tier and whether feedback discusses the actual technical review, CPA handoff or only ordering speed.
cost-seg-smart.model: Property-type and price matrices; publishes CPA coordination, revisions and written support.

rentalwriteoff.priceLabel: $899 for the published residential offer, up to four units.
rentalwriteoff.model: Remote residential offer with expert review and asset documentation.

my-cost-segregation.price: Residential Self-Serve from $497 and Expert Reviewed from $2,500; commercial from $1,497 and $3,500 respectively.
my-cost-segregation.priceQuestion: Which property-value band and review path apply, and are site visits or catch-up work extra?

my-cost-segregation.model: Separate self-serve and reviewed paths; the required tier depends on property value.

costsegez.priceQuestion: Which tier fits the acquisition and renovation facts, and is the advertised audit protection included or an add-on?
costsegez.reviewQuestion: Distinguish the DIY, Engineer Reviewed and Fully Engineered product, and check whether a testimonial references the related MVO brand.
costsegez.model: DIY, Engineer Reviewed and Fully Engineered tiers; eligibility and support differ.

cost-seg-atlas.reviewQuestion: Confirm whether feedback concerns an educational analysis or a professionally reviewed final work product.
cost-seg-atlas.priceLabel: $395 educational analysis; professional review listed as paused.
cost-seg-atlas.model: Educational analyses rather than signed studies; professional review listed as paused.

costseg-express.price: $99 per property for the published technology-assisted planning-study offer.
costseg-express.priceQuestion: What must be updated or professionally reviewed before the planning output supports your actual tax filing?

costseg-express.priceLabel: $99 per property for the published planning-study offer.
costseg-express.model: Technology-assisted planning output; final facts and professional review require clarification.

quickseg.price: Basic Study $595; Study + Audit Support $744 on the researched pricing page.
quickseg.priceQuestion: Does the selected package include the support you need, and who verifies property inputs before filing?
quickseg.priceLabel: Basic Study $595; Study + Audit Support $744 on the researched pricing page.

segwize.price: The researched homepage advertises a flat $550 report fee.
segwize.priceQuestion: Confirm property eligibility, professional review and the support terms included in the advertised report fee.
segwize.priceLabel: The researched homepage advertises a flat $550 report fee.

maven-cost-segregation.model: Maven describes detailed engineering with physical inspection and an in-house engineering and tax team.

seneca-cost-segregation.price: The FAQ describes a free proposal and a study fee determined by square footage, property type and complexity; this source does not provide a numeric study fee.

cssi.price: The cost segregation FAQ publishes a general $2,000–$15,000 range and separately describes commercial fees generally starting at $2,500. Confirm a property-specific quote.
cssi.priceQuestion: Which stated range applies to my building, and what inspection, revision and support work is included?
cssi.priceLabel: General FAQ range $2,000–$15,000; commercial fees generally from $2,500.
cssi.model: CSSI describes an engineering-based property study and an on-site walkthrough.
